name: Hero Rock Barrier charges consume when the wearer takes damage (#11713)
contract: #11713: Rock Barrier (280295) reads 'Lasts for $n attacks or $d. Expending a charge of Rock Barrier launches a Geode at the enemy.' Its Spell.dbc record has ProcCharges 10, ProcFlags 0 and EFFECT_2 SPELL_AURA_PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL (EffectTriggerSpell 280296, Geode). LoadSpellProcs only builds a default entry from a non-zero DBC ProcFlags, so without a `spell_proc` row the aura's charges could never be consumed, matching the report that the barrier only acts as a 10 second armor buff. rev_20261109_840_hero_rock_barrier_proc_11713.sql adds the row (PROC_FLAG_TAKEN_DAMAGE, as for Rock Barrier 503630). Gnomish Death Ray (13493, the self-damage fixture of primalist-5037-rock-barrier-geode.json) deals four Physical periodic ticks; with the row present at least one tick must consume a charge, dropping the remaining count below the DBC starting value of 10.

steps.label: control: it starts at its DBC charge count
Gnomish Death Ray: four Physical periodic ticks
control: the fixture actually dealt damage
at least one taken-damage tick consumed a Rock Barrier charge
